summary: Parked-car kerb along a park edge, shops opposite and no homes close.

drivers.seclusion: Park behind; retail 16 m across road; apartments 23 m east across the junction.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb has cars parked and the park edge is open; van fits along the kerb.
drivers.traffic: Quiet end of the village street by a turning circle, with some shop traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along this kerb, so a van will not stand out.

sun_shade: Open to sun; a few trees west of the section.

best_section.where: Lambert Road kerb on the park side, west of the apartment block
